reviews.title: Overpriced but looks nice
reviews.comment:
It's a strimer cable. Is it overpriced? Very overpriced. But it does save you some hassle of covering your own 24 pin cable with rgb strips when compared to its competitors. After installing it I'm confident that this has been much less of a hassle than trying to get some rgb covers over my PSU 24 pin cables.
The connectors are ridiculously tight with Corsair 24 pin connectors, or other brands that use the same type of cable, such as XPG core reactor II. Took a lot of repeatedly brute force to finally shove them in.
The colors are very accurate compared to the Lian Li software. It is also very noticeably bright at full brightness.
Some planning ahead with cable management to tie the cables at the back of the PC will be necessary to get a good tight look. I was lucky that my case had tons of nooks and crannies for just adding a simple zip tie to lift the cable up.
Overall, very overpriced, but it does look nice. It's also handy for holding small figurines.

reviews.title: Cleanest Cable Upgrade I’ve Ever Used – Zero Clutter, Pure Aesthetic
reviews.comment:
This is hands down one of the best aesthetic upgrades I’ve added to my build. The wireless design is a game changer—no extra cable clutter and setup was way easier than I expected. The controller paired instantly and the lighting effects are smooth, bright, and fully customizable.
Build quality feels premium, and the cables themselves are sturdy without being overly stiff. Installed it in a HYTE Y70 Touch case and it absolutely elevated the look of the entire system.
If you’re going for a clean, high-end build, this is 100% worth it. Not necessary for performance obviously, but for looks—it’s next level.
